title: 第15章 路遇
slug: 夜天子全本免费-夜天子最新章节列表
content_zh:
这里民风与中原大不相同，官府控制力也相对较弱，在一些地理形势恶劣、民风彪悍的地方，县令所能掌控的区域实际上只限于县城。这种情况下治安自然更加恶劣。为安全起见，叶小天总要找到同路的商旅才会上路。
这天他们终于来到了晃州府。只要穿过晃州便有一条贯通南北的道路，他们就可以折向去京城的路，叶小天心中既高兴又担心，高兴的是终于要踏上回家的路，担心的是囊中如今只剩下最后一文钱。
过了晃州城虽有一条贯通南北的道路，可这条路是从莽莽群山之中开辟出来的一条驿道，从晃州到下一座大城之间是一条漫长而曲折的山中驿路，最快也要四天时间才能通过。
在此期间几乎全是崇山峻岭，很难遇到人烟，身无分文且人单势孤的人是无论如何也无法通过的，可叶小天并未因此止步，车到山前必有路，乐观的小天一直相信天无绝人之路。
进城后，花掉最后一文钱，买了三个菜包子，三个人勉强对付了一口，便立即向西城走去。
自从进了晃州城，薛水舞就有些心事重重，只是叶小天此时既喜且忧，全未察觉。薛水舞心事重重，不免落后了几步，望着背着乐遥快步前行的背影，她几度欲言，却终又闭口。
如今眼看西门在即，水舞终于鼓足勇气，快步追上前去，正想对叶小天说些什么，叶小天却突然停住脚步，一把扯起她，飞快地闪向路口街角。
薛水舞吃惊地道：“叶大哥，怎么了？”
叶小天道：“噤声！”
他把乐遥交给水舞，贴着墙角悄悄探出头去，向远处观望一阵，眉心蹙紧，脸色渐渐阴沉下来。
城门处，百姓与商贾们正进进出出，只有两个半死不活地士卒抱臂倚着城门，懒洋洋地打量着进出的百姓，而在城墙阴影下，却有五六个大汉站在那儿。
他们左顾右盼的杵在一个并不十分热闹的城门下格外显眼，其中一人身材干瘦，赫然正是杨三瘦。叶小天万万没有想到，他们居然追来了，而且就守住北返的唯一出口上！
杨三瘦坐在一个石墩上，头戴草帽，正啃着一块西瓜。
他一边吐着瓜子儿，一边乜着出城的百姓。除非有能藏人的车辆，否则他就不用刻意上前检查，叶小天、薛水舞带着一个小孩子，这样的组合很容易辨认。
他那日向靖州北方的官道追出好远，一直没有看到叶小天三人的身影，杨三瘦马上就醒觉不对了，叶小天三人就算是借乘了他人的车子也不可能快得过他们的马，既然追不上，很可能就是落在了他们的后面，或者根本还未离开靖州。
杨三瘦马上兜转快马匹往回搜，一直回到靖州城也没发现叶小天的影子。杨三瘦悻悻地去回禀杨夫人，本以为叶小天三人既然侥幸逃脱也就算了，谁知夫人却下了严令，要他无论如何也要找到水舞母女并置之死地。
杨三瘦不明白夫人为何如此执着，却也只能暗暗腹诽小心眼的女人是何等可怕，作为一个家奴，他不能也不敢违拗主子的命令，只能不折不扣地执行。
可是要抓到叶小天他们谈何容易，杨三瘦费尽周折才打听到叶小天他们向西而去，杨三瘦一路循踪追赶，可每一次都是阴差阳错，晚了一步。
有鉴于此，杨三瘦干脆分出一半人马循踪追赶，自己另带一半人马日夜兼程地抢先赶到晃州府，堵在了这条去往京城的必经之路上。
叶小天对薛水舞道：“杨三瘦来了，就在城门前。”

“什么？”薛水舞听了脸色顿时一白。
叶小天锐利的眼神盯着她，沉声问道：“杨夫人为何非要置你于死地？”
薛水舞满脸迷惘，仔细想了想，摇头道：“我……我也不明白，没有道理啊，她为什么这么恨小……小女子，根本没有道理啊。”
叶小天总觉得水舞的话有些不尽不实，毫无道理的迫害并非没有，如果一个人能享有几乎不受约束的权力，那么丧心病狂也好、肆无忌惮也好，根本就没有道理可讲。
可杨夫人显然没有这样的权力，在她身上还有重重约束，所以她执意如此，就不可能毫无目的或者没有原由。可现在不是逼问的时候，叶小天深深望了水舞一眼，又探出头去观察城门口的动静。

content_en:
The folk customs here are very different from those in the Central Plains, and the government's control is relatively weak. In some places with harsh geographical conditions and strong folk customs, the area that the county magistrate can control is actually limited to the county seat. In this case, public security will naturally become worse. For safety reasons, Ye Xiaotian always has to find a business traveler on the same road before going on the road.
That day they finally arrived at Huangzhou Mansion. As long as they passed through Huangzhou, there was a road connecting the north and the south, and they could turn back to the capital. Ye Xiaotian was happy and worried at the same time. He was happy that he was finally going home, but he was worried that he only had the last penny left in his pocket.
Although there is a road that connects the north and south after passing Huangzhou City, this road is a post road carved out of the vast mountains. From Huangzhou to the next big city is a long and winding mountain post road, which can take up to four days to pass.
During this period, it was almost all lofty mountains, and it was difficult to encounter people. People who were penniless and alone would not be able to pass through anyway. But Ye Xiaotian did not stop because of this. There must be a road before the car reaches the mountains. The optimistic Xiaotian always believed that there is no perfect road for people.
After entering the city, I spent my last penny and bought three vegetable buns. The three of them barely managed to eat them, and then immediately walked towards the west city.
Since entering Huangzhou City, Xue Shuiwu has been a little preoccupied, but Ye Xiaotian is both happy and worried at the moment, so he doesn't notice it at all. Xue Shuiwu was so preoccupied that she inevitably fell a few steps behind. Looking at the back of Leyao who was walking quickly on his back, she wanted to speak several times, but finally kept silent.
Now seeing Ximen approaching, Shui Wu finally summoned up the courage to catch up quickly. Just as he was about to say something to Ye Xiaotian, Ye Xiaotian suddenly stopped, picked her up, and quickly rushed to the corner of the intersection.
Xue Shuiwu said in surprise: "Brother Ye, what's wrong?"
Ye Xiaotian said: "Silence!"
He handed Leyao to Shui Wu, leaned his head quietly against the corner, and looked into the distance for a while, his brows tightened, and his face gradually darkened.
At the city gate, people and merchants were coming in and out. There were only two half-dead soldiers leaning on the city gate with their arms folded, lazily looking at the people coming in and out. Under the shadow of the city wall, there were five or six big men standing there.
They looked around and stood out under a city gate that was not very lively. One of them was skinny, and it was Yang Sanshou. Ye Xiaotian never expected that they would actually catch up and guard the only exit back to the north!
Yang Sanshou was sitting on a stone pier, wearing a straw hat and chewing a piece of watermelon.
While spitting out melon seeds, he looked at the people leaving the city. Unless there is a vehicle that can hide people, there is no need for him to step forward to check. The combination of Ye Xiaotian, Xue Shuiwu and a child is easy to identify.
He chased the official road north of Jingzhou for a long way, but never saw Ye Xiaotian and the others. Yang Sanshou immediately realized that something was wrong. Even if Ye Xiaotian and the others borrowed someone else's car, they couldn't be faster than their horses. Since they couldn't catch up, they probably fell behind them, or they hadn't left Jingzhou at all.
Yang Sanshou immediately turned his horse around and searched back. He didn't find Ye Xiaotian until he returned to Jingzhou City. Yang Sanshou went to report to Madam Yang angrily, thinking that since Ye Xiaotian and the others escaped by chance, it would be alright, but Madam actually issued a strict order, asking him to find Shui Wu and her daughter and put them to death no matter what.
Yang Sanshou didn't understand why his wife was so persistent, but he could only secretly complain about how terrible a small-minded woman was. As a domestic slave, he could not and did not dare to disobey his master's orders, so he could only carry them out to the letter.
But it was not easy to catch Ye Xiaotian and the others. Yang Sanshou had to go through a lot of trouble to find out that Ye Xiaotian and the others were heading west. Yang Sanshou followed them all the way, but every time it was a mistake and he was a step late.
In view of this, Yang Sanshou simply divided half of his men and horses to pursue them, while he took the other half of his men and horses to grab the goods day and night.We rushed to Huangzhou Mansion first and were stuck on the only way to the capital.
Ye Xiaotian said to Xue Shuiwu: "Yang Sanshou is here, right in front of the city gate."
"What?" Xue Shuiwu's face suddenly turned pale after hearing this.
Ye Xiaotian stared at her with sharp eyes and asked in a deep voice: "Why does Mrs. Yang insist on putting you to death?"
Xue Shuiwu looked confused. She thought about it carefully and shook her head: "I...I don't understand either. It doesn't make sense. Why does she hate the little... little girl so much? It doesn't make sense at all."
Ye Xiaotian always felt that Shui Wu's words were somewhat untrue. There was no reason for persecution. If a person could enjoy almost unfettered power, then there would be no reason for him to be crazy or unscrupulous.
But Mrs. Yang obviously does not have such power, and there are still many restrictions on her, so if she insists on doing this, it cannot be without purpose or reason. But now was not the time for questioning. Ye Xiaotian took a deep look at Shui Wu and then stuck his head out to observe the movement at the city gate.
